title: Platform Engineer (Backend Infrastructure)
description:
Position: Infrastructure Engineer
Location: Poland/Europe - Remote
Type: This can be structured as a B2B contract or Employment Contract with full benefits
Poland B2B Annual Rate: $102,000 - $117,500 depending on experience + stock options
Portugal Salary Band: €60,000 - €72,000 depending on experience + stock options
## Who We Are
Focal Systems is the industry leader in retail AI solutions. We are a Silicon Valley-based startup headquartered in San Francisco, with operations in Canada, the UK, multiple EU countries and a tech hub in Poland. We are a Deep Learning-first company. Our mission is to automate and optimize brick-and-mortar retail using deep learning computer vision. Focal Systems has been deployed at scale with some of the top retailers in the world, processing hundreds of millions of images per day across tens of thousands of stores globally.
We were recently named Confluent's inaugural Data Streaming Startup of the Year, a recognition of how seriously we take the engineering challenges at the core of our business.
We seek smart, creative, and passionate people who want to help build a great and enduring company.
## What We're Looking For
We are looking for a Platform Engineer to own the platform that every image from every store passes through: ingestion, Kafka streaming, Python services, GPU model inference, databases, storage, and the GCP and Kubernetes layer underneath. The team is small, so there is no separate SRE, DBA or release team. When a pipeline slows down, you find out whether the cause is a Kafka consumer, a MySQL query, an autoscaler or a node pool, and you fix it, including in the application code. The role is cloud-only, with no on-prem or datacenter hardware, and CI/CD pipelines are a small part of it.
The core challenge is scale. We are processing hundreds of millions of images per day across tens of thousands of retail locations globally, and that number is growing fast. Load will grow by an order of magnitude, and your job is to make sure cost and operational effort do not grow with it.
## What You Will Do
• Own the design, operation and cost of Focal's production platform on GCP: Kubernetes, Kafka, MySQL, MongoDB, Redis, object storage.
• Drive measurable reductions in COGS and latency, for example lowering GPU inference cost per store through machine types, batching, autoscaling or scheduling, and report the numbers.
• Read, debug and change Python (FastAPI, Kafka consumers) backend services. Platform problems are often fixed in application code, for example a MySQL query that ran fine at 1,000 stores and times out at 10,000.
• Fix throughput bottlenecks such as consumer lag at store opening, whether the cause is partition count, consumer throughput, a downstream database or autoscaling reaction time.
• Rework metrics, alerts and dashboards so the on-call engineer can tell which stores and regions are affected when an alert fires. Take part in incident response, postmortems and capacity planning.
• Build tooling that gives engineers access to data across regions and storage systems in minutes instead of days.
• Maintain infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, Helm) and the deployment path to production, and work with the backend, deep learning and edge teams so the platform keeps up with new products and models.
## What You Need to Be Successful
## Must have
• Python as a software engineer, not only for scripting. You will contribute to backend code every week.
• 5+ years building and operating production backend systems on a cloud platform. GCP preferred; deep AWS or Azure experience is fine.
• Hands-on production experience operating at least one stateful system under load: Kafka or another streaming platform, MySQL/PostgreSQL, or MongoDB. We mean partitioning, replication, lag, slow queries and failover, not only provisioning.
• Kubernetes in production, including scheduling, resource limits, autoscaling with KEDA, GPU node pools and debugging misbehaving pods.
• Debugging production incidents across layers (application, messaging, database, orchestration, network), with examples you can walk us through.
• Observability with Prometheus, Grafana, Grafana Mimir and Sentry, or equivalent: instrumenting code, writing useful alerts.
• Terraform or another infrastructure-as-code tool.
## Nice to have
• MySQL query tuning; Kafka internals (consumer group rebalancing, partition strategy, throughput tuning), Confluent Cloud and Kafka Connect.
• GPU workloads or ML inference serving in production (Ray/KubeRay or similar), and cloud cost optimization with measured results.
• Go, Snowflake, Airflow, CircleCI, Helm, and blue/green or canary releases.
## About you
• You take ownership of problems end to end and follow them into whichever layer they lead.
• You make decisions from data (profiles, metrics, query plans, cost reports) and prioritize well in startup/scaleup environments.
• Advanced written and spoken English.
• Comfortable coordinating across time zones with a global team.
• Comfortable with a shared on-call rotation.
## Why Focal Systems
Strong Values and Mission - We are a tightly-knit team with an ambitious mission and a strong set of core values, which define our approach to business and have successfully guided us since inception.
Exceptional Team - We are a team of hard-working, fun-loving professionals from some of the most eminent universities, research labs, and tech companies of our time. We pride ourselves on recruiting exceptional individuals to help us redefine the state-of-the-art.
Outstanding Partners - We work with some of the largest retailers in the world and have a world-class roster of investors, advisors and partners to support & advise us in our endeavors.
What we offerWe care deeply about the health, happiness, and wellbeing of all of our employees. We offer:
• Competitive Salary & Attractive Stock
• Paid Time Off
• Team Retreats
• Education grants
Note: Our pay bands are driven by market benchmarks in the target geography for hiring. Our posted ranges typically include multiple job levels. A candidate's level is determined by their performance throughout our talent acquisition process including technical screens, behavior interviews, presentations, work samples, and references. We will communicate transparently with the candidate at final stages regarding how we have leveled them, and what salary range that places them into. Placement within range is equally determined by education, general experience in your profession, specific experience in our domain, and your performance in the talent acquisition process. It is rare to receive an offer at the top of the range for a role.

title: Full Stack Developer
description:
## Full-Stack Developer
Position Type: Remote
Location: U.S. Business Hours
## About the Role
We’re looking for a skilled, self-driven Full-Stack Developer to build, maintain, and improve product features across both front-end and back-end systems.
In this role, you’ll take ownership of features from initial design through deployment, collaborate with other engineers, and contribute to a reliable, scalable codebase. The ideal candidate combines strong technical skills with proactive communication, sound engineering judgment, and the ability to deliver high-quality work without constant supervision.
## What You’ll Own
## Full-Stack Development
• Build, maintain, and improve features across front-end and back-end systems.
• Write clean, well-tested, scalable, and maintainable code.
• Work with modern front-end frameworks such as React, Vue, or equivalent technologies.
## Feature Development & Ownership
• Take ownership of features from initial design and development through deployment.
• Collaborate with the technical team to define requirements and deliver solutions aligned with product goals.
• Manage development tasks effectively to ensure timely delivery.
## Code Quality & Reviews
• Participate in code reviews and uphold engineering standards.
• Follow collaborative development practices, including Git workflows and pull requests.
• Contribute to a codebase that is reliable, maintainable, and easy for the team to work with.
## Bug Triage & Resolution
• Investigate, diagnose, and resolve issues across the technology stack.
• Prioritize fixes based on user needs and business impact.
• Support testing, deployment, and post-release monitoring.
## Technical Collaboration
• Work closely with engineers and stakeholders to scope requirements and evaluate technical tradeoffs.
• Communicate progress, raise blockers early, and ask clarifying questions when requirements are unclear.
• Balance rapid delivery with long-term maintainability and product quality.
## Required Experience & Skills
• Proven experience as a Full-Stack Developer, with a track record of delivering production-ready features.
• Proficiency in modern front-end technologies such as React, Vue, or equivalent frameworks.
• Experience with back-end frameworks and server-side development.
• Solid understanding of databases, RESTful API design, and system integration patterns.
• Experience with Git, pull requests, code reviews, and collaborative development workflows.
• Ability to write clean, testable, and maintainable code.
• Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to troubleshoot issues across the stack.
• Strong written English communication skills for working effectively with a distributed team.
• Ability to work independently, manage priorities, and take ownership of deliverables.
## What Makes You a Strong Fit
• You can own a feature end-to-end, from initial implementation through deployment and monitoring.
• You communicate proactively, flag blockers early, and clarify requirements before making assumptions.
• You value code quality without allowing perfectionism to delay delivery unnecessarily.
• You approach code reviews as opportunities to collaborate and improve.
• You adapt to feedback, work well with others, and make thoughtful technical decisions.
• You understand how to balance immediate product needs with long-term maintainability.
## What Success Looks Like
• Product features are delivered on time and meet agreed requirements.
• Code is clean, tested, scalable, and maintainable.
• Bugs are investigated and resolved according to their impact.
• Technical risks and blockers are communicated early.
• Code reviews, testing, documentation, and deployment are consistently part of the development process.
• The team can rely on you to take ownership and deliver with minimal supervision.
## Typical Day
Your day will focus on building and improving the product. You may start by reviewing open pull requests, then move into focused development work on a feature or bug fix. Throughout the day, you’ll communicate progress and blockers asynchronously, collaborate with teammates on technical decisions, and contribute to testing, deployments, and documentation.
## Interview Process
• Initial Screening
• Recruiter Interview
• Client Interview
• Offer & Onboarding

description:
## About Virtuozzo
Virtuozzo is a provider of infrastructure software for AI and the cloud, helping cloud service providers, SaaS companies, and enterprises build and operate efficient, scalable infrastructure. We combine an optimised operating system with orchestration, management, automation, and protection to deliver mainframe-like efficiency, performance, reliability, versatility, and security—while reducing overall cost and complexity.
Our Virtuozzo Infrastructure System (V/IS) brings together compute, storage, and networking to support traditional applications, cloud-native workloads, and AI services. We help organisations modernise their infrastructure, make better use of their hardware, and bring new cloud- and GPU-powered services to market on their own infrastructure and under their own brand.
Our technology serves more than 100,000 companies in over 100 countries. With deep engineering roots, we pioneered container-based virtualisation and continue to contribute to foundational open-source projects, including OpenVZ, the Linux kernel, Kubernetes, CRIU, KVM, and OpenStack.
## The Role
Our team develops the V/IS and we are looking for Engineers to join our team. As a Software Engineer, you will play a key role in building new features, optimizing performance, and ensuring reliability in production environments. • Familiarity with distributed systems design and implementation.
• Background in system programming.

• Proficiency with automation and infrastructure tools such as Ansible, Bash scripting, and Terraform.
• Knowledge of Kubernetes orchestration.
• Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.
• Web development skills (JavaScript, HTML).
## What We Offer
• Remote and flexible work from European locations.
• A collaborative engineering culture focused on deep technical challenges and real-world impact.
• A chance to influence the design and evolution of a global-scale cloud infrastructure platform.
• Professional development opportunities through training, certifications, and mentoring.
• Group private medical insurance / medical allowance.
• Employee/Contributors recognition programmes and incentives.
• Referral programme bonuses.

description:
## About the Role
Join a team supporting physical AI projects by collecting high-quality data from real-world human movement and manipulation. Your recordings and task evaluations will help train embodied AI systems to interact with the physical world.
## What You'll Do
Operate robots through teleoperation using VR controllers or leader arms while data is recorded.
Capture clear egocentric task footage with head-mounted cameras.
Perform and document hands-on tasks such as folding, sorting, assembling, and cooking.
Set up and operate motion capture and sensor systems, including motion capture cameras, IMUs, and LiDAR.
Film, photograph, and scan physical spaces, work areas, and objects for scene data.
Evaluate robot performance on assigned tasks and score results.
## What We're Looking For
Zero to five years of experience in robotics operations, teleoperation, motion capture, VFX, camera or drone operation, laboratory work, autonomous vehicle testing, or skilled trades.
Experience operating physical equipment or sensors with careful, repeatable technique, such as robots, camera rigs, drones, motion capture systems, test vehicles, or precision tools.
Ability to follow written capture protocols and accurately log each recording.
Familiarity with ROS or ROS 2, VR controllers, leader-follower teleoperation, OptiTrack or Vicon, IMUs, LiDAR, GoPro, or head-mounted cameras is helpful.
Ability to complete projects at home or work with provided equipment, or travel for on-site projects.
## Compensation & Benefits
Compensation is $20 to $40 per hour, depending on project, field, and experience. Payment is based on hours worked.
## Location
Remote projects are available, with some assignments requiring on-site work. Some projects can be completed from home or your workplace using provided equipment.

title: Applied ML Engineer, Agents & Automation
description:
## About the Role
We're looking for an Applied ML Engineer, Agents & Automation to design, build, and deploy intelligent systems that automate complex workflows across Bask Health's telehealth platform.
Bask Health brings together merchant operations, patient experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy coordination, and commerce tools. Many of these processes involve multiple applications, structured information, business rules, and repetitive tasks. You'll help build AI-powered systems that can coordinate these steps while operating within clearly defined permissions and reliability requirements.
This role focuses on developing production AI agents that use large language models, application tools, retrieval systems, and workflow orchestration to complete approved tasks. You'll work on the technical infrastructure that allows agents to retrieve information, select appropriate tools, execute actions, handle failures, and maintain context throughout multi-step processes.
You'll combine applied machine learning with strong software engineering practices. Depending on the use case, this may involve model selection, fine-tuning, task-specific evaluation, or other machine learning techniques that improve agent performance. You'll also recognize when deterministic software and conventional automation are more reliable than model-driven decisions.
Your work may support merchant operations, internal administrative processes, patient-related coordination, and pharmacy workflows. You'll collaborate with product managers, backend engineers, applied AI engineers, and operational stakeholders to identify opportunities where automation can reduce manual work and improve consistency.
Because Bask operates in healthcare-related environments, agents must be designed with appropriate safeguards, access controls, auditability, and human approval requirements. You'll help ensure that automated systems operate within approved business and clinical boundaries and do not independently perform actions that require licensed professional judgment.
This is a hands-on engineering position with meaningful ownership over agent behavior, automation architecture, and production reliability. You'll build reusable systems, measure their performance, and improve them based on real-world results.
We're looking for someone who understands both the potential and limitations of AI agents and enjoys building systems that are useful, measurable, secure, and dependable.
## What You'll Do
• Design, build, and deploy AI agents that automate approved workflows across Bask Health's platform.
• Develop agent architectures that combine large language models, tools, APIs, and application logic.
• Build multi-step automation systems that coordinate tasks across multiple services.
• Implement reliable tool-calling and function-execution capabilities.
• Develop agent orchestration logic for task planning, execution, and completion.
• Build reusable components for agent state management, context handling, and workflow execution.
• Integrate AI agents with internal APIs, databases, and approved external services.
• Develop retrieval capabilities that provide agents with relevant information and application context.
• Design structured outputs and validation systems for agent-generated actions.
• Implement permission checks and authorization controls for automated tool execution.
• Build human approval and confirmation steps for sensitive or consequential actions.
• Develop safeguards against prompt injection, unauthorized actions, and unreliable model behavior.
• Implement retry logic, error recovery, timeouts, and fallback mechanisms.
• Build monitoring and tracing systems that make agent behavior observable and debuggable.
• Create automated tests for tool selection, workflow execution, and task completion.
• Develop evaluation datasets and benchmarks for agent accuracy and reliability.
• Measure agent success rates, task completion, latency, and operational costs.
• Investigate agent failures and improve prompts, tools, models, and orchestration logic.
• Evaluate whether model adaptation, fine-tuning, or alternative ML approaches improve task performance.
• Collaborate with product teams to identify repetitive workflows suitable for automation.
• Develop AI-powered automation for merchant configuration and operational tasks.
• Support approved administrative workflows involving patient and pharmacy coordination.
• Work with backend engineers to integrate agent systems into production infrastructure.
• Design event-driven automation triggered by approved application events.
• Optimize agent performance, infrastructure usage, and model inference costs.
• Build internal tools that help engineers inspect, test, and troubleshoot agent workflows.
• Participate in architecture discussions, code reviews, and engineering planning.
• Own assigned automation initiatives from technical design through deployment and continuous improvement.
## Requirements
• 3+ years of professional experience in software engineering, machine learning engineering, or a closely related technical field.
• Experience building and deploying production software applications.
• Strong programming skills in Python, TypeScript, or comparable languages.
• Hands-on experience developing AI-powered applications or intelligent automation systems.
• Familiarity with large language models and modern generative AI development techniques.
• Experience integrating model APIs into production software.
• Understanding of tool calling, function calling, and AI application orchestration.
• Experience building backend services and application APIs.
• Familiarity with asynchronous programming and distributed application workflows.
• Understanding of workflow state management and multi-step process execution.
• Experience integrating internal services, databases, and third-party APIs.
• Familiarity with structured model outputs and schema validation.
• Understanding of prompt engineering and model behavior evaluation.
• Ability to identify and troubleshoot unreliable AI-generated outputs.
• Experience designing automated tests for production software.
• Familiarity with logging, monitoring, and production troubleshooting.
• Understanding of authentication, authorization, and secure API design.
• Ability to implement error handling, retries, and recovery mechanisms.
• Familiarity with cloud-based application deployment.
• Understanding of data pipelines and structured application data.
• Ability to evaluate technical tradeoffs between AI-driven automation and deterministic software.
• Experience working with Git, code review, and collaborative engineering practices.
• Ability to translate operational requirements into reliable technical solutions.
• Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills.
• Ability to independently own engineering projects and communicate effectively with cross-functional teams.
## Nice to Have
• Experience building production AI agents or agent-based automation systems.
• Familiarity with LangGraph, LangChain, Semantic Kernel, or comparable agent orchestration frameworks.
• Experience with OpenAI, Anthropic, or similar model APIs.
• Experience implementing multi-agent workflows or coordinated agent execution.
• Familiarity with retrieval-augmented generation and vector search.
• Experience building AI applications with persistent state or long-running workflows.
• Experience with event-driven architectures and workflow engines.
• Familiarity with AWS Lambda, SQS, EventBridge, or comparable cloud services.
• Experience with Temporal or similar durable workflow orchestration platforms.
• Experience with model fine-tuning, supervised learning, or task-specific model adaptation.
• Familiarity with machine learning evaluation methodologies and experiment tracking.
• Experience developing benchmarks for agent task completion and tool-use accuracy.
• Experience with agent observability and tracing tools.
• Familiarity with human-in-the-loop approval systems.
• Experience implementing sandboxed tool execution or restricted automation environments.
• Understanding of prompt injection risks and agent security practices.
• Experience building automation for SaaS platforms or e-commerce operations.
• Familiarity with healthcare, telehealth, or pharmacy-related workflows.
• Understanding of HIPAA and healthcare data privacy considerations.
• Experience using AI-assisted development tools such as Cursor or Claude Code.

Bask Health is a software platform that enables entrepreneurs, doctors, and healthcare businesses to launch, manage, and grow direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses.
Our platform brings together patient experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy operations, and commerce tools in one place.
We're an entrepreneurial, product-focused engineering team that values ownership, technical excellence, and building software that solves real problems. Engineers work closely with product teams and company leadership, take features from idea to production, and have a direct role in shaping the platform.
Engineering at Bask is AI-first and builder-led. We use tools like Cursor and Claude Code throughout development while maintaining high standards for reliability, testing, and software quality.
## About the Role
We're looking for a Machine Learning Engineering Intern to join Bask Health's engineering team and gain practical experience developing machine learning models, working with real application data, and supporting production ML systems.
Bask Health provides the technology behind direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses, connecting merchant storefronts, patient experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy operations, and commerce capabilities. As we expand our machine learning capabilities, we're looking for motivated individuals who want to learn how intelligent systems are developed, evaluated, and integrated into real software products.
You'll work alongside experienced machine learning engineers, applied AI engineers, software engineers, and product teams to contribute to machine learning projects across the platform.
This internship is designed to provide hands-on engineering experience. Rather than focusing exclusively on theoretical research, you'll learn how machine learning models are developed, tested, improved, and prepared for use in production applications.
Your work may include preparing datasets, exploring model architectures, implementing training scripts, evaluating model performance, and helping integrate machine learning capabilities into existing software systems.
You'll gain exposure to practical machine learning workflows, including feature engineering, experiment tracking, model validation, performance monitoring, and reproducible development practices.
You'll also learn how engineering teams evaluate whether a machine learning solution is appropriate for a product problem, compare model approaches, and balance accuracy with reliability, latency, and operational cost.
You'll receive guidance from experienced engineers while contributing to appropriately scoped projects. As you develop your skills, you'll have opportunities to take greater ownership of technical tasks and communicate your findings to the team.
Because Bask operates in healthcare-related environments, you'll learn how privacy, secure data handling, appropriate permissions, and human oversight affect machine learning development. You'll work with approved datasets and established safeguards, and your work will not involve independently making clinical decisions or determining patient treatment.
We welcome candidates who have developed machine learning skills through university coursework, independent projects, research, internships, hackathons, or self-directed learning. Previous professional machine learning engineering experience is not required.
We're looking for someone who enjoys programming, is curious about how machine learning systems work, and wants to develop the practical engineering skills needed to build reliable intelligent software.
## What You'll Do
• Assist with developing machine learning models and supporting engineering systems across Bask Health.
• Work with experienced engineers to understand practical machine learning development workflows.
• Prepare, clean, and transform approved datasets for model training and evaluation.
• Write Python scripts for data processing, experimentation, and model development.
• Assist with implementing supervised learning models and baseline algorithms.
• Explore classification, regression, ranking, and other machine learning approaches.
• Help develop feature engineering pipelines for machine learning applications.
• Assist with training, validating, and evaluating machine learning models.
• Compare model performance using appropriate evaluation metrics.
• Help investigate model errors and unexpected predictions.
• Support the development of reproducible machine learning experiments.
• Document model configurations, datasets, assumptions, and evaluation results.
• Assist with building automated data validation and model testing workflows.
• Learn how machine learning models are integrated into backend services and APIs.
• Contribute to small machine learning application features under engineering guidance.
• Assist with model inference testing and performance measurement.
• Help monitor model behavior and investigate reliability issues.
• Work with engineers to understand model deployment and production monitoring processes.
• Assist with developing scripts and utilities that support ML engineering workflows.
• Explore techniques for improving model accuracy, efficiency, and generalization.
• Help identify data quality issues that affect model performance.
• Participate in code reviews and incorporate feedback from experienced engineers.
• Learn and follow Bask Health's software engineering and machine learning development standards.
• Use version control and collaborative development tools to manage assigned work.
• Collaborate with software engineers and product teams to understand machine learning use cases.
• Present experiment results, technical findings, and project progress to team members.
• Learn about responsible machine learning practices and secure data handling.
• Complete assigned machine learning engineering projects with mentorship, documentation, and appropriate testing.
## Requirements
• Currently pursuing, recently completed, or independently developing skills equivalent to a degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Software Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related technical field.
• Foundational programming skills in Python or a comparable language.
• Basic understanding of machine learning concepts and common algorithms.
• Familiarity with supervised learning, including classification or regression.
• Understanding of basic programming principles and data structures.
• Familiarity with data processing and manipulation techniques.
• Basic knowledge of Python libraries such as NumPy, pandas, or comparable tools.
• Understanding of model training, validation, and testing concepts.
• Familiarity with common machine learning evaluation metrics.
• Basic understanding of probability, statistics, or linear algebra.
• Ability to write and debug Python scripts.
• Familiarity with structured datasets and tabular data.
• Basic understanding of SQL or willingness to learn database querying.
• Familiarity with Git or willingness to learn version control workflows.
• Ability to read technical documentation and follow implementation instructions.
• Interest in building practical machine learning applications.
• Willingness to learn machine learning frameworks and development tools.
• Understanding of basic software testing and debugging practices.
• Ability to explain technical concepts and experiment results clearly.
• Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills.
• Attention to detail when working with datasets and model outputs.
• Ability to collaborate with engineers and other technical team members.
• Openness to feedback and mentorship.
• Ability to manage assigned tasks and communicate progress.
• Strong curiosity about production machine learning systems and their real-world applications.
## Nice to Have
• Academic, personal, research, or internship projects involving machine learning.
• Experience using scikit-learn, PyTorch, TensorFlow, or comparable ML frameworks.
• Familiarity with model training and hyperparameter tuning.
• Experience developing classification, regression, or recommendation models.
• Basic understanding of neural networks and deep learning.
• Familiarity with natural language processing or text classification.
• Experience working with Jupyter notebooks or comparable development environments.
• Familiarity with data visualization libraries.
• Experience using SQL to query and analyze datasets.
• Exposure to feature engineering and data preprocessing techniques.
• Familiarity with model evaluation metrics such as precision, recall, F1 score, or ROC-AUC.
• Experience using GitHub to share programming or machine learning projects.
• Exposure to cloud platforms such as AWS, Google Cloud, or Azure.
• Familiarity with MLflow, Weights & Biases, or comparable experiment tracking tools.
• Basic understanding of model deployment and inference APIs.
• Experience participating in machine learning competitions, hackathons, or research projects.
• Familiarity with recommendation systems, ranking models, or predictive analytics.
• Interest in healthcare technology, telehealth, or e-commerce applications.
• Basic awareness of data privacy, model bias, and responsible machine learning.
• Experience using AI-assisted development tools such as Cursor or Claude Code.

## About the Role
We're looking for an Applied ML Engineer, Care Experience to develop intelligent software capabilities that improve how patients receive support and navigate ongoing care-related experiences through Bask Health's platform.
Bask Health provides the technology behind direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses, connecting patient onboarding, clinical workflows, pharmacy coordination, and ongoing patient interactions. These processes often involve communication, administrative follow-ups, operational handoffs, and coordination between multiple systems and teams.
You'll help build machine learning and AI-powered features that make these experiences more consistent, efficient, and easier to manage for patients and authorized care teams.
This is a hands-on applied machine learning engineering role that combines large language models, predictive modeling, backend development, and workflow automation. You'll work with approved patient-related information, application events, APIs, and model outputs to develop intelligent features that support care-related operations.
Your work may include intelligent message classification, administrative request routing, AI-assisted communication, workflow prioritization, and systems that help authorized teams identify incomplete or delayed operational tasks.
You'll collaborate with product managers, applied AI engineers, machine learning specialists, and clinical or pharmacy operations stakeholders to understand workflow requirements and translate them into reliable software capabilities.
You'll also help evaluate model accuracy, monitor production behavior, and improve machine learning systems based on real-world performance. You'll need to understand when traditional software rules, predictive models, or large language models are most appropriate for a particular problem.
Because these applications support healthcare-related workflows, accuracy, privacy, appropriate permissions, and human oversight are essential. You'll build systems that support authorized professionals and administrative processes without independently diagnosing patients, recommending treatments, prescribing medications, or making clinical decisions.
This position emphasizes practical engineering, measurable improvements, and responsible deployment. You'll contribute to technical design, build production features, and continuously improve systems based on user feedback and evaluation results.
We're looking for an engineer who enjoys applying machine learning to real operational challenges, understands the importance of dependable software in sensitive environments, and wants to help make ongoing care experiences easier to manage.

At Empower, joining our team means more than starting a new role. It means becoming part of a mission-driven organization that’s transforming healthcare at scale. We invest deeply in our people, encourage bold thinking, and create opportunities for growth, leadership, and innovation at every level. Your ideas matter here, your development is supported, and the work you do has a direct impact on the lives of millions.
If you thrive in a fast-moving, purpose-driven environment where innovation, collaboration, and ambition come together, Empower Pharmacy is the place for you. Let’s transform healthcare together.
## POSITION SUMMARY
The Software Engineer - Full Stack drives measurable business impact by building scalable, secure, and high-performing digital platforms that accelerate product delivery, operational efficiency, and customer outcomes.
This role owns end-to-end development across modern web frontends, APIs, microservices, and data layers, ensuring resilient architecture and seamless cloud integration. Leveraging AI as a force multiplier, the engineer enhances development speed, code quality, system reliability, and data-driven decision-making.
Operating within Empower's hyper-growth, highly regulated 503A/503B environment, this position ensures compliance, scalability, and innovation coexist. The role demands talent characterized by strong strategic thinking, disciplined execution, and continuous learning agility, enabling rapid adaptation to evolving technologies, regulatory expectations, and business priorities while consistently delivering high-impact, enterprise-grade software solutions that support mission-critical healthcare operations and long-term digital transformation objectives.
## RESPOSIBILITIES
## Platform Engineering
Full Stack: Design, develop, and optimize end-to-end applications using C#, Python, TypeScript, React.js, Next.js, Java, Spring Boot, Node.js, and GraphQL. Integrate modern frontends, APIs, and microservices-based backend services while leveraging AI-assisted coding and testing tools to accelerate delivery, improve code quality, and ensure scalable, secure, and maintainable system architecture aligned with enterprise standards.
API Development: Build and enhance RESTful APIs that enable seamless data exchange across systems. Apply AI-driven monitoring and performance tuning to improve latency, reliability, and scalability while ensuring compliance with security and regulatory standards within a highly controlled healthcare technology environment.
Cloud Architecture: Engineer cloud-native solutions across AWS and Azure using Infrastructure as Code. Leverage AI-powered optimization tools to enhance resource utilization, system resilience, and cost efficiency while maintaining high availability and compliance in a rapidly scaling, regulated ecosystem.
## DevOps and Automation
Pipeline Automation: Develop and manage CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps. Integrate AI-driven automation to streamline build, test, and deployment processes, reduce cycle times, and ensure consistent, reliable software delivery across environments with strong governance and traceability.
Infrastructure Management: Implement Terraform-based infrastructure automation, utilizing AI insights for predictive scaling, anomaly detection, and performance optimization to ensure stable, efficient, and compliant infrastructure that supports continuous delivery and evolving business demands.
Release Engineering: Drive release quality through automated testing, monitoring, and rollback strategies enhanced by AI, ensuring minimal downtime, rapid issue resolution, and consistent deployment outcomes aligned with enterprise reliability and regulatory expectations.

Bask Health supports direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses through technology that connects patient experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy operations, and commerce systems. These workflows involve structured information, administrative tasks, operational coordination, and interactions between multiple teams and applications.

## About Us
Content Mindset is a small but growing video editing agency. We partner with social media teams to handle 100% of their video editing needs. You will be working alongside a team of editors, and you'll be getting edits that push you to grow as an editor.
We are hiring a freelance short-form video editor dedicated to one of our clients: a software company that markets to e-commerce brands. The client posts 3 times per week, and you will be the editor behind those videos.
## The Style
The main inspiration for this role is Rourke's Instagram page:
Study it before you apply. Think cinematic AI-generated scenes, bold animated text, fast pacing, and motion graphics that keep every second visually interesting. We want videos that feel like they were made by someone who lives on the internet and genuinely loves what AI can do for video.

Editing 3 short-form vertical videos per week for our client
Using AI tools to generate animations, visuals, and scenes that bring each script to life
Building motion graphics: animated text, popups, callouts, and UI highlights
Sourcing B-roll, including screen recording B-roll from e-commerce brand websites (storefronts, product pages, checkout flows)
Adding and proofreading captions on every video
Working with our team on review notes and revisions
## Pay
This is a freelance role paid per video, at $50 USD per video. At 3 videos per week, that's $150 USD per week. We also give our editors a $10 weekly bonus, just for being a part of the team. Payment is always sent Friday evening PST. We also host our team meetings Friday evening PST.

Adobe Premiere Pro 2026 (non-negotiable)
Very comfortable using AI tools for video. You use AI image and video generators (Runway, Kling, Higgsfield, Luma, Veo, or similar) to create animations and scenes, and you keep up with new tools as they come out
Strong motion graphics skills
Comfortable sourcing B-roll and recording clean, high-quality screen recordings of websites (smooth scrolling, clean cursor movement, high resolution)
Internet-native. You understand short-form, trends, retention, and what makes someone stop scrolling
Excited about AI and always trying to get better as an editor. You take feedback well and actively look for ways to level up
Very communicative and enjoys being part of a team
Reliable turnaround. The client posts 3 times per week, so hitting deadlines matters
Fluent / Almost Fluent English speaker
Premiere captioning isn't the best with grammar, you'd be expected to correct this on your own
Comfortable with large file sizes (50+ GB in some cases)
Open to working with us long term

title: Azure Devops Engineer
description:
## The salary for this role is £45,000 - £50,000.
Are you a hands-on DevOps engineer who enjoys solving live issues and making platforms better each week?
Can you turn Azure, CI/CD, and Infrastructure as Code into smooth, reliable delivery pipelines?
Would you love the opportunity to build secure Azure pipelines that keep real, live services running every day?
If so, we’d love to hear from you!
At Livestock Information Ltd, our mission is to be an outstanding service provider of livestock data, empowering government, industry, and farmers to effectively manage disease and infection control, whilst enhancing productivity and innovation in agriculture. To achieve this, we need great people, who share in our values.
As an Azure DevOps Engineer, you’ll design and manage DevOps pipelines across PaaS-based Azure environments, embedding secure-by-design principles and meeting industry and government security standards.
You’ll work closely with development, operations, and security teams to deliver automated, secure, and scalable services, while supporting live and non-production platforms. The role includes 3rd-line support, break-fix and out-of-hours cover on a shift basis, platform optimisation, and providing hands-on technical support to development teams.
## Responsibilities
## Your responsibilities will include
• Deploying, monitoring, maintaining and improving our Azure platform
• Providing timely and efficient break-fix support to resolve system issues and minimise downtime in line with Service Level Agreements including out-of-hours.
• Monitoring system performance, availability, and capacity, perform infrastructure as code optimisation to ensure cost efficiency and reliable service.
• Providing 3rd line support for live Azure Platform services, addressing complex issues and coordinating with internal teams to maintain service uptime.
• Delivering and supporting the customers’ infrastructure requirements for service enhancements and new projects.
• Leveraging deep expertise in Microsoft Azure’s IaaS, PaaS and SaaS offerings to design, implement, and managing cloud-based solutions that align with business and technical needs.

• Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams and stakeholders and communicate technical concepts and solutions in a clear and concise manner.

title: AI Video Editor (BBS951)
description:
We're looking for an AI Video Editor to own AI-driven short-form video creative for a well-established clinical skincare brand with a strong presence across Southeast Asia. You will start from a script or outline for each video, storyboard it from the brand's product and video catalog, and turn it into finished social content in the style beauty brands are producing with AI today, matched to the brand's look. Sometimes the starting point will be a vague concept, and you will turn that into a finished video too.
This role sits closer to a creative director or creative manager who also makes the work than to a pure editor. The brand team is short on capacity, which is why they are hiring overseas, so they need someone self-sufficient who does not need babysitting. You will study the brand's website and Instagram on your own, pick up its look and voice quickly, and get it right the first time. Constant rework costs time and AI generation credits, so a fast read on the brand matters. If you are fluent in AI video editing, have the tools you need, and can take a loose idea to a polished, on-brand video without hand-holding, this role is a strong fit.
## Why You'll Want to Join
• You will be paid in USD (bi-monthly: every 15th and 30th)
Paid Time Off in accordance with company policy
• Observance of Holidays per company guidelines
100% remote setup so you can work wherever you're most productive
• Work on content for a globally recognized skincare brand with an active and growing Southeast Asian social media presence
• High-ownership creative role with real autonomy over concept, storyboard, and finished output
## What You'll Work On
## Creative Direction and Storyboarding
• Start from a script or outline for each video and develop it into a clear concept and storyboard
• Take a vague video concept and turn it into a finished video without waiting for detailed direction
• Storyboard from the brand's product and video catalog so every video is grounded in real products and existing brand assets
• Study the brand's website and Instagram on your own to understand its look, tone, and audience, and apply it correctly the first time
## AI Video Production
• Produce AI-driven short-form videos for Instagram Reels, TikTok, and other platforms in the style beauty and skincare brands are publishing now, matched to the brand's look
• Use AI video and image tools fluently across ideation, generation, editing, and finishing
• Cut, reformat, and enhance assets into finished, platform-ready content with motion graphics, text overlays, transitions, music, and sound design
• Produce approximately 100 finished videos per month consistently and on schedule
• Do not use AI to generate human faces, skin, or realistic human imagery of any kind; all human and skin visuals must come from brand-provided assets
## Quality, Efficiency, and Self-Management
• Get the brand right the first time to avoid constant rework that burns time and AI generation credits
• Work with your own AI tools and platforms and keep your workflow current as new tools emerge
• Run your own projects with minimal supervision and flag asset gaps or brief issues early
• Organize files and deliver finished videos in the correct formats for each platform
## Requirements
## What You Bring
• Fluency in AI video editing and generation tools, with a portfolio of AI-driven short-form content
• Proven ability to take a vague concept and turn it into a finished, on-brand video
• Creative direction instincts including concepting, storyboarding, and the taste to make confident creative decisions
• Ability to study a brand's website and social presence and quickly absorb its look and voice
• Self-sufficiency: you need little training and do not need babysitting
• Your own AI tools and platforms, ready to use from day one
• Strong short-form editing skills in Adobe Premiere Pro, CapCut, DaVinci Resolve, or similar platforms
• Understanding of the limits on AI use, including no AI-generated human faces or skin
• Speed and efficiency at high volume without sacrificing quality
• Organized and reliable with consistent on-time delivery
• Available to work during Southeast Asia business hours
## Nice to Have
• Beauty, premium skincare, or makeup experience, since those candidates tend to know how to tell the story
• Experience creating AI content for beauty or consumer lifestyle brands
• Mandarin language skills for supporting Chinese-language content production
• Familiarity with Southeast Asian social media audiences and platform trends
• Experience with motion graphics or basic animation for social media content
• Background producing content for Instagram Reels or TikTok at scale
## How to Apply
## Please include:
• Your updated resume
• A portfolio link showing at least 4 to 6 finished AI-driven short-form videos, ideally in a beauty or premium consumer style
• A short Loom video (1 to 2 minutes) introducing yourself, describing your AI video workflow and tools, and walking through one video you took from a vague concept to a finished piece, including your storyboard and creative decisions
Shortlisted candidates will complete a short homework assignment: take a loosely defined video concept and turn it into a finished video.
Only candidates who submit both a portfolio and Loom video will be moved to the next step of the hiring process.
If you are a self-sufficient creative who can turn a loose idea into an on-brand AI video without hand-holding, this role gives you the autonomy and the direct impact to do your best work.
## Benefits
## Application Process Overview
Our comprehensive selection process ensures we find the right fit for both you and our clients:
Initial Application - Submit your application and complete our prequalifying questions
Video Introduction - Record a video introduction to showcase your communication skills and work experience
Role-Specific Assessment - Complete a homework assignment tailored to the position (if applicable)
Recruitment Interview - Initial screening with our talent team
Executive Interview - Meet with senior leadership to discuss role alignment
Client Interview - Final interview with the client team you'd be supporting
Background & Reference Check - Professional reference verification
Job Offer - Successful candidates receive a formal offer to join the team
Each stage is designed to evaluate your fit for the role while giving you insights into our company culture and expectations. We'll keep you informed throughout the process and provide feedback at each step.

title: Frontend Engineer, Sites & Studio
description:
## About Bask Health
Bask Health is a software platform that enables entrepreneurs, doctors, and healthcare businesses to launch, manage, and grow direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses.
Our platform brings together patient experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy operations, and commerce tools in one place.
We're an entrepreneurial, product-focused engineering team that values ownership, technical excellence, and building software that solves real problems. Engineers work closely with product teams and company leadership, take features from idea to production, and have a direct role in shaping the platform.
Engineering at Bask is AI-first and builder-led. We use tools like Cursor and Claude Code throughout development while maintaining high standards for reliability, testing, and software quality.
## About the Role
We're looking for a Frontend Engineer, Sites & Studio to help build and improve the website creation, customization, and visual editing experiences within Bask Health's platform.
In this role, you'll develop frontend features that allow merchants to create, manage, and customize their digital storefronts and patient-facing websites. You'll work on tools that make complex website configuration accessible through intuitive interfaces, reusable components, and flexible editing experiences.
You'll collaborate closely with designers, product managers, and backend engineers to develop tools for page editing, layout customization, content management, and website publishing. Your work will help merchants build professional digital experiences while maintaining consistency, performance, and reliability across the platform.
This position combines strong frontend engineering fundamentals with an interest in visual interfaces, design systems, and interactive product development. You'll help create editing tools that are easy to use while supporting the flexibility needed for different merchants and business models.
You'll contribute throughout the development process, from planning and implementing new features to improving existing functionality, debugging issues, and refining the overall user experience.
We're looking for someone who enjoys building polished interfaces, solving challenging interaction problems, and creating software that gives users more control over their websites without requiring advanced technical knowledge.
## What You'll Do
• Build and maintain frontend features for Bask's Sites & Studio experiences.
• Develop website creation, editing, and customization interfaces using React, Next.js, and TypeScript.
• Build intuitive tools that allow merchants to manage their website content and appearance.
• Develop reusable components for page layouts, sections, forms, and interactive website elements.
• Implement visual editing functionality for configuring pages and storefront experiences.
• Build interfaces for editing text, images, colors, typography, and layout settings.
• Develop responsive website templates and configurable page components.
• Implement live previews that reflect changes made through editing tools.
• Create intuitive controls for managing website sections and reusable content blocks.
• Support drag-and-drop or other interactive editing experiences where appropriate.
• Build interfaces for managing navigation, page structure, and content organization.
• Develop functionality for saving, updating, and publishing website changes.
• Integrate frontend editing tools with backend APIs and content management services.
• Collaborate with designers to translate visual concepts into flexible frontend components.
• Work with backend engineers to define data structures for configurable website content.
• Improve the usability and consistency of website editing workflows.
• Build responsive interfaces that function across desktop and mobile devices.
• Help maintain consistent styling and behavior across customizable merchant websites.
• Optimize frontend performance for editing tools and published website experiences.
• Implement reliable form validation, loading states, and error handling.
• Write clean, maintainable, and well-tested frontend code.
• Develop automated tests for important editing and publishing workflows.
• Investigate and resolve frontend issues involving rendering, layout, and interactions.
• Participate in code reviews and contribute to frontend architecture decisions.
• Help improve reusable design systems and component libraries.
• Collaborate with product teams to identify opportunities for better merchant customization.
• Take ownership of assigned features from development through deployment and maintenance.
## Requirements
• 3+ years of professional experience in frontend or full-stack software engineering.
• Strong professional experience developing web applications with React.
• Proficiency in JavaScript and TypeScript.
• Experience with Next.js or comparable modern frontend frameworks.
• Strong knowledge of HTML, CSS, and responsive web development.
• Experience building interactive, component-based user interfaces.
• Strong understanding of reusable component architecture.
• Experience implementing complex frontend interactions and application state.
• Familiarity with modern CSS approaches and component styling techniques.
• Experience translating design specifications into functional interfaces.
• Understanding of responsive layouts and cross-browser compatibility.
• Experience integrating frontend applications with REST APIs or comparable backend services.
• Familiarity with asynchronous data fetching and client-server communication.
• Experience building configurable user interfaces or data-driven components.
• Strong debugging and troubleshooting skills.
• Understanding of frontend performance optimization.
• Familiarity with web accessibility and usability principles.
• Experience working with Git and collaborative software development workflows.
• Familiarity with frontend testing tools and automated testing practices.
• Ability to write clean, maintainable, and well-documented code.
• Experience collaborating with product managers, designers, and backend engineers.
• Strong attention to detail when implementing visual designs and interactive behavior.
• Ability to independently manage assigned features and technical responsibilities.
• Strong communication and problem-solving skills.
• Comfort working in a fast-moving, remote engineering environment.
## Nice to Have
• Experience building website builders, visual editors, or no-code/low-code platforms.
• Experience developing drag-and-drop interfaces or interactive editing tools.
• Familiarity with rich-text editors or content editing frameworks.
• Experience with libraries such as dnd-kit, Lexical, TipTap, or ProseMirror.
• Experience building configurable page layouts or component-based website templates.
• Familiarity with content management systems and structured content models.
• Experience developing live-preview or real-time editing functionality.

• Manejo sólido de SQL para extracción, validación, modelado y optimización de consultas.
• Experiencia operando pipelines de datos en ambientes cloud, idealmente AWS.
• Conocimiento práctico de Redshift y de estructuras de data warehouse.
• Experiencia trabajando con data lakes, integración de fuentes y capas de transformación.
• Experiencia con Airflow y dbt.

title: Forward Deployed AI Engineer (m/f/d)
description:
Agile Robots SE is an innovative company with a clear mission: bringing intelligent robotic solutions to our customers. We combine the latest technology in the field of AI with powerful robotic systems — from industrial robot arms and mobile manipulators to humanoids — to solve tasks that classical automation cannot address.

At the heart of our offering is a versatile software platform for orchestrating complex robotic systems. It allows efficient customization for specific customer requirements: configuring systems, developing reusable skills, parameterizing processes, and executing tasks reliably in production. Learned models — from perception to end-to-end policies — are a core part of this platform.

Our solutions are deployed with international customers across a wide range of industries. Seamless integration and scalable deployment are at the core of our mission.

We are looking for a passionate Forward Deployed AI Engineer to bring state-of-the-art robot learning and computer vision models into real production environments. In this role, you will train, fine-tune, and deploy AI models directly on customer robots — from Vision-Language-Action models and diffusion policies to perception and grasp generation networks. You will become a trusted technical partner, turning customer challenges into robust, data-driven robotics applications. The role is based in Munich, Germany.

Responsibilities

  • Deploy, fine-tune, and evaluate AI models on real robotic systems at customer sites — including Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models, diffusion policies, and other end-to-end learned policies
  • Adapt and train perception models for robotic applications, e.g. object detection, segmentation, and pose estimation based on YOLO, SAM, vision transformers, and self-supervised backbones such as DINOv2
  • Integrate and tune grasp generation models (e.g., GraspNet, Dex-Net, Contact-GraspNet) for bin picking and manipulation tasks
  • Build data pipelines for customer deployments: demonstration and teleoperation recording, dataset curation, annotation, training runs, and systematic evaluation of model performance
  • Bring models into production: optimize inference, deploy on edge and embedded hardware, and integrate models into our robotic software platform
  • Work closely with customers to understand technical requirements and translate them into robust, AI-driven robotics applications
  • Diagnose, troubleshoot, and resolve model, software, and system integration issues both remotely and on-site
  • Travel to international customer sites for workshops, deployments, training, and technical support (up to 40% travel)

Essential Skills

  • Master's degree in Robotics, Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, or a related field — or equivalent practical experience
  • Minimum of four years of professional experience in machine learning, AI for robotics, or computer vision
  • Hands-on experience working with real robots — robot arms, mobile manipulators, grippers, cameras, and sensors — not only in simulation
  • Proven experience with end-to-end learned models for robotics (e.g., VLAs, diffusion policies, imitation or reinforcement learning policies), covering training, fine-tuning, and deployment
  • Strong programming skills in both Python and C++
  • Solid command of machine learning frameworks (e.g., PyTorch, TensorFlow) and the full model lifecycle: data curation, training, evaluation, and deployment
  • Experience with modern computer vision models such as YOLO, SAM, vision transformers, and self-supervised backbones (e.g., DINOv2, CLIP)
  • Experience with learned grasp generation for manipulation (e.g., GraspNet, Dex-Net, or comparable approaches)
  • Good understanding of robot (inverse) kinematics, coordinate transformations, and hand-eye calibration
  • Experience working in Linux environments
  • Willingness to learn new technologies and adapt quickly in customer environments
  • Fluency in English

Beneficial Skills

  • Experience with large-scale demonstration data collection, teleoperation setups, and sim-to-real transfer
  • Experience with robot learning simulation frameworks (e.g., NVIDIA Isaac Sim/Lab, MuJoCo, Gazebo)
  • Good understanding of classical computer vision (e.g., OpenCV, PCL, camera calibration, point cloud processing)
  • Experience optimizing inference (e.g., TensorRT, ONNX, quantization) and deploying on NVIDIA embedded platforms (e.g., Jetson Orin, AGX, Xavier)
  • Experience with MLOps tooling: experiment tracking, dataset versioning, and continuous training or evaluation pipelines
  • Publications or open-source contributions in robot learning, manipulation, or computer vision
  • Familiarity with industrial automation environments (e.g., PLCs, EtherCAT, OPC UA)

 

What we offer

  • A dynamic high-tech company, combined with financial soundness and world-class investors.
  • Join an interdisciplinary, international team with 60+ different nationalities in a collaborative work environment.
  • Lots of development opportunities as we continue to grow.
  • Challenging tasks and impactful projects alongside experts that enable professional and personal growth.
  • Corporate Benefits Program covering health, mobility, and learning for 100€ net per month.
  • Modern office facilities with a rooftop terrace overlooking Munich, free drinks & fruits, and regular company events contribute to a good working environment

About us

Agile Robots is a leading provider of AI-powered robotics solutions. By combining artificial intelligence and robotics, the company makes industries smarter, more flexible, and more efficient. 

Founded in Munich in 2018 by renowned robotics researchers from the German Aerospace Center (DLR), Agile Robots has experienced rapid global growth. Today, more than 3,500 highly skilled robotics and AI enthusiasts are employed worldwide. The company has one of the largest research and development teams in the AI and robotics industry. 

Agile Robots has built a unique portfolio; together with the subsidiaries BÄR Automation, Franka Robotics, idealworks, and Krause Automation, the company covers all areas of AI-driven robotics.

title: Postdoc / Research Engineer (Acoustic Heart Failure Monitoring: Multimodal and clinical integration)
description:
About TUMCREATE
TUMCREATE is a multidisciplinary research platform of the Technical University of Munich (TUM) at the Singapore Campus for Research Excellence and Technological Enterprise (CREATE). We are partnering with universities, public agencies, and industry to advance future technologies.
Our public-private research partnership program, HEARTwise - Heart Failure Assessment with Reliable Technology using Wearables and In Vitro Diagnostics - is funded by Singapore’s National Research Foundation (NRF) and represents a collaborative effort between the Technical University of Munich (TUM), the National University Health System (NUHS), the National Heart Centre Singapore (NHCS), and the National University of Singapore (NUS). Within the TUM CREATE HEARTwise team, we are developing a novel in vitro diagnostic readout platform for stochastic point-of-care sensing.
As a member of the HEARTwise team, you will collaborate within an interdisciplinary consortium comprising leading experts in cardiology, telemedicine, biomedical engineering, acoustics, data privacy, and industry.
Please visit www.tum-create.edu.sg for more information about TUMCREATE.
Background& Scientific Context
Heart failure (HF) affects 2.5% of Singapore's population and is the leading cardiac cause of hospital admission – presenting a decade earlier and more aggressively than in Europe or North America. The 30% rehospitalization rate within 90 days of discharge is both a major clinical burden and a window of opportunity for early, data-driven intervention.
The HEARTwise project is a public-private research initiative funded by Singapore's National Research Foundation, bringing together clinical cardiologists (CADENCE/ NUHS, NHCS), engineers from TUM and TUMCREATE, and MedTech partners. The project develops a multimodal platform for non-invasive, early decompensation detection in ambulant HF patients – combining wearable mobility sensing, heart and lung sound recognition, and integration with additional digital biomarker sources.
Job Summary
We are seeking a highly motivated and skilled researcher with proven expertise in signal processing, in user or patient research studies, and in creating software for participant testing. You will collaborate with clinicians and be responsible for audio data collection of heart and lung sounds in the clinic, for creating an annotated database, and for validating sound classification prototypes in a pilot clinical diagnostic study. You will work on algorithms for classification of heart and lung sounds and develop approaches for integrating multimodal data from mobility sensing and other biomarkers to create a reliable tool for early decompensation detection in ambulant HF patients.
This is a fixed-term contract for a period of 3 years when applicable.
Key Responsibilities
• Work on classification algorithms of heart and lung sounds, on multimodal data analysis and fusion, and on verifying the technology against requirements.
• Work with clinicians on data collection from heart failure patients and build a database under consideration of data protection and ethical requirements
• Develop a tool for audio data collection in the clinic, advance it into a clinical audio classification prototype and validate it in a pilot clinical study.
• Collaborate with experts in cardiology, telemedicine,biomedical engineering, acoustics, and data privacy
• Write scientific manuscripts, contribute to project reports, and present findings at international conferences and stakeholder meetings.
Key Competencies
• At least 1 year of proven expertise in signal processing,user or patient studies, and in creating software for participant testing.
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to communicate complex analytical results to multidisciplinary teams.
• Demonstrated ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced, international research environment.
Qualification Requirements
• We are seeking a researcher with a PhD degree in hearing research, electrical engineering,biomedical engineering, human factors engineering, (medical) physics, computer science or similar and a proven track record in (audio) signal processing and in developing and conducting research studies with users or patients. PhD candidates will also be considered.
• Proficiency in C/C++, Matlab/Python and anaconda(or similar).
• Experience in machine learning and database interfacing is highly desirable.
• Ideally, the candidate has an interdisciplinary education including acoustics that facilitates collaboration with biomedical engineers.
What we offer

title: Content Designer, AI Experiences
description:
## About Bask Health
Bask Health is a software platform that enables entrepreneurs, doctors, and healthcare businesses to launch, manage, and grow direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses.
Our platform brings together patient experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy operations, and commerce tools in one place.
We're an entrepreneurial, product-focused engineering team that values ownership, technical excellence, and building software that solves real problems. Engineers work closely with product teams and company leadership, take features from idea to production, and have a direct role in shaping the platform.
Engineering at Bask is AI-first and builder-led. We use tools like Cursor and Claude Code throughout development while maintaining high standards for reliability, testing, and software quality.
## About the Role
We're looking for a Content Designer, AI Experiences to help shape how users interact with AI-powered capabilities across Bask Health's software platform.
Bask Health enables entrepreneurs, doctors, and healthcare businesses to launch, manage, and grow direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses. Our platform brings together merchant tools, patient experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy operations, and commerce capabilities.
As we explore and develop AI-assisted product experiences, clear communication becomes essential. Users need to understand what an AI feature can do, what information it uses, when its output may be incomplete, and which decisions remain their responsibility.
As a Content Designer, AI Experiences, you'll design the language and conversational patterns that make AI-powered functionality understandable, useful, and appropriately transparent.
This is a hands-on product content role combining UX writing, conversational design, interaction design, content strategy, and cross-functional product development. You'll work with product designers, product managers, engineers, and AI-focused technical teams to create content for AI-assisted workflows.
Your work may include AI-powered assistants, suggested actions, generated summaries, guided configuration experiences, automated recommendations, and other intelligent product capabilities as they are developed and approved.
You'll help define how AI features introduce themselves, explain their capabilities, ask for information, present results, communicate uncertainty, and guide users toward appropriate next steps.
You'll also design content for situations where AI cannot complete a task, produces an incomplete result, needs clarification, or requires human review. These experiences should help users understand what happened without creating unnecessary confusion or implying capabilities the system does not have.
A major part of this role will involve creating clear boundaries between AI assistance and user decisions. You'll help design messaging that distinguishes suggestions from completed actions, makes important limitations visible, and supports review before consequential changes.
Because Bask operates in healthcare-related environments, you'll need to pay particular attention to privacy, accuracy, and appropriate clinical boundaries. You'll collaborate with relevant stakeholders to ensure AI-related content does not misrepresent medical authority, treatment eligibility, or actions requiring authorized human oversight.
You'll participate throughout the product development process, from early concept exploration and prototype writing through usability testing, implementation, and iteration.
You'll also contribute to reusable AI content patterns, including response structures, clarification prompts, confirmation language, error states, and disclosure guidelines.
You'll use user research, usability feedback, and available product data to evaluate whether people understand AI-generated content and can successfully complete their tasks.
We're looking for someone who enjoys solving new product communication challenges, understands the importance of responsible AI interactions, and can translate technically complex functionality into straightforward, useful experiences.
## What You'll Do
• Design clear, intuitive content for AI-powered features across Bask Health's platform.
• Write interface copy for AI-assisted merchant and operational workflows.
• Develop conversational interaction patterns for assistants and guided experiences.
• Create introductory messaging that explains what AI features can and cannot do.
• Write prompts, suggested questions, and guided input instructions for users.
• Design content for AI-generated summaries, recommendations, and suggested actions.
• Help users distinguish AI-generated suggestions from verified information and completed actions.
• Create clear explanations for automated processes and AI-assisted workflows.
• Develop content patterns for uncertainty, incomplete information, and unavailable results.
• Write clarification prompts that help users provide missing or ambiguous information.
• Design confirmation messages for actions that require user review or approval.
• Create recovery messaging for unsuccessful or interrupted AI interactions.
• Develop appropriate handoff language when human assistance or review is required.
• Collaborate with product designers on conversational layouts and AI interaction flows.
• Partner with engineers to understand AI functionality, limitations, and system behavior.
• Work with product managers to define user expectations and content requirements.
• Participate in the design of AI-assisted merchant configuration experiences.
• Help create understandable content for AI-generated business insights and operational summaries.
• Review AI feature prototypes for clarity, transparency, and usability.
• Develop reusable writing patterns for AI-related product interactions.
• Contribute AI content standards to Bask Health's broader design system.
• Establish consistent terminology for AI features, generated outputs, and automation states.
• Collaborate with researchers to evaluate user understanding and trust.
• Test whether users can identify AI limitations and appropriately review suggested actions.
• Work with clinical and pharmacy stakeholders when AI experiences involve sensitive healthcare workflows.
• Apply accessibility and plain-language principles to conversational and AI-generated interfaces.
• Document content decisions, AI interaction patterns, and writing guidelines.
• Own assigned AI content design projects from initial discovery through implementation and iteration.
## Requirements
• 3+ years of professional experience in content design, UX writing, conversational design, product writing, or a closely related field.
• Portfolio or work samples demonstrating content design for digital products.
• Strong writing, editing, and information organization skills.
• Understanding of user-centered content design principles.
• Experience creating interface content for web or mobile applications.
• Ability to simplify technically complex concepts into clear, actionable language.
• Experience writing instructions, guidance, error messages, confirmations, and system states.
• Strong understanding of information hierarchy and interaction design principles.
• Familiarity with conversational interfaces, AI-assisted products, or automated workflows.
• Ability to design content that sets clear user expectations.
• Understanding of transparency and user control in automated experiences.
• Ability to communicate uncertainty and product limitations without confusing users.
• Experience collaborating closely with product designers and product managers.
• Ability to work effectively with software engineers and technical stakeholders.
• Familiarity with Figma or comparable collaborative product design tools.
• Understanding of accessibility and inclusive writing principles.
• Experience maintaining consistent terminology across digital experiences.
• Familiarity with UX writing guidelines or content design systems.
• Ability to review prototypes and identify content-related usability problems.
• Experience incorporating research findings and user feedback into content improvements.
• Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
• Ability to explain writing decisions and communicate recommendations clearly.
• Experience working in cross-functional product teams.
• Ability to balance user needs, business requirements, and technical constraints.
• Ability to independently manage assigned content design projects.
## Nice to Have
• Direct experience designing content for generative AI products.
• Experience with conversational AI assistants or chatbot interfaces.
• Familiarity with large language models and their practical limitations.
• Experience designing AI-assisted workflows for SaaS applications.
• Understanding of prompt design and user-facing prompt guidance.
• Experience creating content patterns for AI-generated recommendations.
• Familiarity with human-in-the-loop review and approval workflows.
• Experience designing interfaces that communicate AI uncertainty.

• Experience developing reusable conversational design patterns.
• Understanding of localization and accessibility challenges in AI interfaces.
